mapper.insert: insert into chain_room (chain_room_name, status, chain_room_capacity, turn_time_limit_base_sec, host_member_id) values (#{chainRoomName}, 'WAITING', #{chainRoomCapacity}, #{turnTimeLimitBaseSec}, #{hostMemberId})
mapper.select: select chain_room_id as chainRoomId, chain_room_name as chainRoomName, status as status, chain_room_capacity as chainRoomCapacity, turn_time_limit_base_sec as turnTimeLimitBaseSec, host_member_id as hostMemberId, current_turn_member_id as currentTurnMemberId, current_turn_deadline as currentTurnDeadline, last_chain_word_id as lastChainWordId, winner_member_id as winnerMemberId, reg_date as regDate, started_date as startedDate, ended_date as endedDate from chain_room where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}

select chain_room_id as chainRoomId, chain_room_name as chainRoomName, status as status, chain_room_capacity as chainRoomCapacity, turn_time_limit_base_sec as turnTimeLimitBaseSec, host_member_id as hostMemberId, reg_date as regDate from chain_room where status = 'WAITING' order by reg_date desc
mapper.update: update chain_room set status = #{status} where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}
update chain_room set host_member_id = #{hostMemberId} where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}
update chain_room set status = 'ENDED', ended_date = now(), current_turn_member_id = null, current_turn_deadline = null, winner_member_id = #{winnerMemberId} where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}
mapper.insert: insert into chain_room_member (chain_room_id, member_id, turn_no, lives, score, eliminated_yn) values (#{chainRoomId}, #{memberId}, #{turnNo}, 3, 0, 'N')
mapper.delete: delete from chain_room_member where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from chain_room_member where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}

select crm.chain_room_id as chainRoomId, crm.member_id as memberId, crm.turn_no as turnNo, crm.joined_date as joinedDate, crm.left_date as leftDate, crm.lives as lives, crm.eliminated_yn as eliminatedYn, crm.score as score, crm.final_rank as finalRank, crm.eliminated_date as eliminatedDate, m.member_name as memberName, m.member_profile_image as memberProfileImage from chain_room_member crm join member m on m.member_id = crm.member_id where crm.chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId} order by crm.turn_no asc

select chain_room_id as chainRoomId, member_id as memberId, turn_no as turnNo, joined_date as joinedDate, left_date as leftDate, lives as lives, eliminated_yn as eliminatedYn, score as score, final_rank as finalRank, eliminated_date as eliminatedDate from chain_room_member where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId} and member_id = #{memberId}
select max(turn_no) from chain_room_member where chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId}

select r.chain_room_id as chainRoomId, r.chain_room_name as chainRoomName, r.status as status, r.chain_room_capacity as chainRoomCapacity, r.winner_member_id as winnerMemberId, r.started_date as startedDate, r.ended_date as endedDate from chain_room r join chain_room_member crm on crm.chain_room_id = r.chain_room_id where crm.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = 'ENDED' order by r.ended_date desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select count(*) from chain_room r join chain_room_member crm on crm.chain_room_id = r.chain_room_id where crm.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = 'ENDED'
select chain_room_id from chain_room where status = #{status}
